properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1/SHA-2 family supplied to the web3 stack via hash.js (a dependency of elliptic). Dependency inventory — what npm install ships; no direct application call site in this React dApp. See also LIB-e966a74e, the library face of the same package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum's transaction-signature curve, shipped by the @alch/alchemy-web3 → web3/ethereumjs stack. This is the app's ONLY live cryptography: nft-minter/src/util/interact.js:125-128 sends eth_sendTransaction, which MetaMask signs with ECDSA over secp256k1 (reported as a separate finding at the call site — the lockfile object records the shipped library, the finding records the use). Observable here; replaceable only by the Ethereum protocol itself, not by this repo — a deadline risk, not harvest-

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey@1.0.0/1.0.3, the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF. Required by browserify-aes@1.2.0 and browserify-cipher@1.0.1 inside the crypto-browserify@3.12.0 polyfill stack that react-scripts 4 (webpack 4 node shims) and web3.js bundle into the browser app. Shipped in the build; no direct call site in the application code (the app delegates all signing to MetaMask).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.0, the bcrypt-based KDF used with tweetnacl's secretbox/box key derivation. Ships in the bundle as part of the tweetnacl dependency tree; no direct call site in the application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge@0.10.0 ships a full RSA implementation (keygen, encrypt, sign). In this tree node-forge is pulled in by webpack-dev-server via selfsigned@1.10.8 to generate the dev-server's self-signed HTTPS certificate — toolchain/dev use, changeable here by upgrading the dependency. Available in the shipped library; no application call site. Migration: RSA keygen/signing moves to ML-DSA / hybrid TLS for the dev-server cert.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh@4.0.x, crypto-browserify's in-browser implementation of crypto.createECDH (ECDH over secp256k1/curve25519 etc. via elliptic). Bundled into the app by react-scripts 4 webpack shims and web3.js. Shipped in the build; no direct call site in application code. Quantum-relevant as a classical key-agreement primitive available in the bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5 provides Ed25519 signatures (nacl.sign). Ships in the dependency tree (required via crypto-browserify-era polyfill deps); available in the shipped library, no application call site. Quantum-relevant signature scheme available in the bundle; migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA if ever used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA over secp256k1 as implemented by elliptic — the JS signing library inside the @alch/alchemy-web3 → web3 stack. Same primitive as ALG-673c8f24 (the secp256k1 native-binding package) reached through a different library; both ship with npm install. No direct application call site — the app's live signing is performed by the user's MetaMask wallet (see finding at nft-minter/src/util/interact.js:125-128).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5 provides X25519 (scalar multiplication key agreement, nacl.box). Available in the shipped library; no application call site. Harvest-now-decrypt-later class if used for key agreement; migration ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum's hash — used by the ethers/web3 stack for transaction hashes, address derivation and ABI encoding. Quantum-safe against Shor (Grover-only exposure); no PQ action needed. Dependency inventory: ships with npm install; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password KDF of the web3/ethers keystore (JSON v3) wallet-encryption path. Ships with the build but is never exercised by this app's code: the user's keys live in MetaMask and no local keystore is created. Dependency inventory; no iteration count is pinned at these declaration sites (library defaults apply). See also LIB-ea49d4c1, the library face of the same package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@3.0.x, the memory-hard KDF used by web3-eth-accounts/ethers (BIP-3 V3 keystore passphrase derivation); also required directly by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 at nft-minter/package-lock.json:6279. Ships in the bundle; the app itself keeps keys in MetaMask, so no direct application call site. scrypt is not Shor-vulnerable but is Grover-weakened; it is the standard Ethereum keystore KDF.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge@0.10.0 ships AES (CBC/GCM/CTR). Available in the shipped library; no application call site (the dev toolchain uses node-forge only for cert generation). Note a second, separate AES source is in the tree: browserify-aes@1.2.0 (crypto-browserify/web3 path), reported separately as a new finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5's secretbox primitive (XSalsa20-Poly1305 AEAD). Available in the shipped library; no application call site. Symmetric AEAD — only Grover-weakened, not Shor-broken — but it is the authenticated-encryption primitive the build ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ships XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox, Ed25519 and X25519 (all Shor-vulnerable) in node_modules whether or not this app calls them. Available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application — presence is the inventory question here. The XSalsa20-Poly1305/Ed25519/X25519 algorithm objects (other scout's shard) cover this same library's primitive surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA, X.509 and TLS machinery shipped in the bundle via node-forge (pulled in by selfsigned under the web3 stack). No application call site. The RSA and X.509 objects in the other shard cover the primitives this library provides — this entry records that the implementation ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: selfsigned@1.10.8 generates the webpack-dev-server self-signed HTTPS certificate at dev time (using node-forge RSA). Dev toolchain use — the production app is served elsewhere; the asset is changeable here by upgrading webpack-dev-server/selfsigned or configuring a real cert. The private key never leaves the developer machine.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge@0.10.0's X.509 certificate machinery (create/parse/sign certs), exercised at dev time by selfsigned@1.10.8 for the webpack-dev-server HTTPS certificate (self-signed, RSA-2048). Available in the shipped library; no application call site beyond the dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Memory-hard KDF used by the web3/ethers stack for keystore (JSON v3) wallet encryption. Ships unexercised — this app holds no local keys (MetaMask signs). A different package from the native 'scrypt' package the scrypt algorithm object (other shard) covers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1/SHA-2 hash streams shipped to the web3 stack via sha.js (a dependency of hash.js, which elliptic uses for Ethereum key operations); no application call site. Records that the implementation ships — see ALG-50e53f84 for the hash-family algorithm view supplied through it.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

No application call site; the X.509 and X.509-self-signed objects (other shard) cover the certificate artifacts this produces — this entry records that the generator ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
